entries.what: Labor Day at home with Theo; Hana is on leave too, so they split bottles while Elliot logs feeds in the spreadsheet. Pays rent through the Marisol Gardens portal.
entries.outcome: Rent paid, log up to date

entries.what: Afternoon stroller loop near Delgado Park, where families are picnicking for the holiday. Theo naps in the stroller despite the squeaky wheel.
Evening witching hour of crying from 5 to 8; Elliot hums the ballpark organ tune and takeout pho from Phở Bến Thành shows up for dinner.
Morning feeds and diaper logging; Elliot researches formula options for Theo's fussiness before the pediatrician visit.
entries.outcome: List of questions for Dr. Fong

entries.what: Midday contact nap on the couch while he works on the lighthouse jigsaw one-handed.
Tuesday night baby laundry in the card-only Marisol Gardens laundry room.
Visit with Dr. Fong at the Plaza Marisol clinic about Theo's fussiness; she suggests switching to a gentle partially hydrolyzed formula.
Picks up the gentle formula at Ruiz Family Market-area store run and updates the log with the new formula column.
Evening crying stretch; Hana takes a shift while Elliot eats leftovers.
Takes Theo to Thursday 10:30 baby story time at the library for the first time and meets Kaitlyn, who adds him to the Flats Little Readers group chat.
Afternoon nap attempts in the bassinet fail; Elliot logs every minute and ends up doing contact naps again.
Evening trial of the gentle formula; Theo seems a bit less gassy and Hana and Elliot compare notes.
3 a.m. feed: Theo refuses the bottle and Elliot has put the diaper on backwards twice; he messages the assistant joking about it before asking if bottle refusal is serious.
entries.outcome: Theo eventually takes half a bottle

entries.what: Morning sleep-deprived stretch; Elliot naps briefly while Hana handles Theo.
Friday night baby laundry, with distant sounds of the Egrets football opener drifting from the stadium.
Saturday morning trip to Ruiz Family Market with Theo in the carrier; delivery now only for diapers.
Afternoon at home; Elliot logs naps and tries the crib mattress in the spare room for a future move.
Evening witching hour; Hana and Elliot take turns pacing the hallway while a neighbor's door stays shut.
Slow Sunday morning; Elliot takes the 2 a.m. feed aftermath and sleeps in a little while Hana has the 5 a.m.
Stroller walk around the complex and a look at the spreadsheet's weekly totals for formula and naps.
Takeout dinner again; he wonders aloud when he will cook a real meal.
